description: On the table there’s a clear tennis-ball can with a red lid, two yellow tennis balls, and the lid lying nearby. The right hand holds the can steady while the left hand reaches in to remove the red lid, then picks up a tennis ball and drops it into the open top; next the left hand retrieves another tennis ball and inserts it as well, and finally moves back to place the red lid onto the can’s opening while the right hand continues to stabilize the can.
